ShortDescription.Value: Opt-in adaptive distance detail with performance monitoring. LOD changes restore at close views; FPS gains are not guaranteed.

Publish.LongDescription:
BETA — performance monitoring, not a guaranteed FPS boost.
WHAT IT DOES Samples FPS and available frame-time/draw counters. Main-thread time includes waits and rendering work; these readings do not prove that simulation is the bottleneck.
HOW TO USE Open FT on the top-left toolbar. Adaptive Detail reduces native LOD distance at aerial views and restores your current value at close views. Options → FastTrack lets you opt in and tune the maximum reduction. Pause restores LOD and disables FastTrack until re-enabled.
CURRENT LIMITATIONS Adaptive Detail is off by default and trades some distant detail for rendering work; an FPS gain is not guaranteed and requires in-game benchmarking. The runtime LOD change is not written to graphics settings or city saves. Experimental loading boost remains OFF by default and adjusts upload budgets only during city loading. Unsupported profiler counters show as unavailable. This source candidate needs in-game visual, performance, and lifecycle regression before release.
Publish.ChangeLog:
1.3.5-beta.2 — Adaptive Detail prototype
Added opt-in adaptive LOD reduction at distant camera heights, with runtime restoration and a configurable maximum reduction. Loading-budget tuning remains an explicit opt-in experiment.
The source builds; in-game appearance, performance gains, and lifecycle restoration are not yet verified.
